groups.algorithm: Disjoint inner-coordinate slabs, each retaining the complete ordered input-row traversal
alternatives: Serial fallback for narrow inner dimension
Index bucketing only as a separately budgeted multi-launch algorithm
groups.ownership: Each core exclusively owns aligned accumulator columns; no inter-core reduction
groups.synchronization: Same explicit runner stream; retain source producer/consumer barriers until separately justified
groups.task_partition: Aligned inner slabs across available AIV, independently updating every segment
groups.workspace_formula: num_segments * ceil(inner/16)*16 * accumulator_item_bytes; maximum instantiated bytes shown

alternatives: Parallelize aligned finish rows after measured feedback
groups.ownership: Single writer to accumulator; all output segments covered
groups.synchronization: Same explicit runner stream; retain source producer/consumer barriers until separately justified
groups.task_partition: One AIV for accumulation and source-compatible output projection
groups.workspace_formula: num_segments * ceil(inner/16)*16 * accumulator_item_bytes; maximum instantiated bytes shown

precision_invariants: FP16/bfloat16 accumulate in FP32 and cast once; FP32 and integer accumulation retain original order.
Do not introduce atomics, partial-tree reassociation or integer narrowing without a new numerical proof.
semantic_invariants: For every segment and inner coordinate, sum rows whose segment ID matches, in original input-row order.
Per-call accumulator reset and final output projection/conversion are mandatory complete-call operations.
All segment outputs, including empty segments, must be emitted.
